messages:
olivia: Quick sync — I sketched a review owner map for the cross-repo change touching SDK -> API auth header, console -> backend wiring, and the helm chart bump for runtime image. Need owners and an ordering so we don't block each other. Summary: SDK change (sdk repo) -> API adapter bump (api repo) -> console wiring + helm bump (console + charts). Canaries for API/runtime.

samir: Links? drop the PRs here and I'll take SDK ownership if that helps.

olivia: sdk: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/442
api: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/777
runtime: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/123
console: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/88
helm chart: https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/55

maya: I can pick up sdk#442. plan is small interface tweak + integration test.

kevin: I can review api#777 but I need the SDK integration test and a passing CI run before I approve.

olivia: CI currently shows auth header mismatch in api integration tests. Quick repro in local: 
```bash
# simulate old header handling
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer token' http://api.internal/v1/whoami
# runtime expected X-Rwd-Auth header for new flow
```
Fix in runtime is a one-line parse change, runtime#123 has that but not yet propagated to charts.

deploy-bot: CI status — sdk#442: failing checks (integration), api#777: pending, runtime#123: green, console#88: pending, charts#55: draft

tia: If SDK merges first we should do an API canary rollout (10% traffic) before pushing console. Can we schedule tonight 22:00 PT for canary?

samir: :thumbsup: I can merge SDK once I get a green integration run. I'll watch for maya's test commit. After merge I'll open a short follow-up to toggle the compatibility flag.

maya: pushing the integration test to sdk#442 in ~20–30m. It’s a tiny add: assert header mapping and a smoke call to local api stub.

kevin: holding until that lands. @samir when you merge SDK, can you add a release note line so QA knows what to watch for?

samir: will do.

olivia: Helm note for charts#55 — we need the image tag bumped to `rwd-runtime:1.3.4-canary` and set values: 
```yaml
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/redwood/runtime
  tag: 1.3.4-canary
canary:
  enabled: true
```
@zane can you dry-run and confirm there are no templating issues?

zane: confirmed — `helm upgrade --install --dry-run --namespace rwd-staging charts/ --set image.tag=1.3.4-canary` returns OK. Will also smoke the staging chart in 15m.

kevin: After sdk+api are merged, I'd like console#88 gated behind an API smoke test to ensure runtime header mapping is live. Who will run that?

tia: I can run the smoke and watch canary metrics. Scheduling note: 22:00 PT for the canary. I'll post the rollout plan in #deploys 30m before.

olivia: Fantastic. Ownership map recap: SDK -> @maya/@samir, API review -> @kevin, runtime chart -> @zane, console merge gating -> @tia. Ordering: sdk -> api canary -> runtime chart canary -> console. If anyone can't do their slot, ping me and we'll reassign.

samir: I'll ping again if CI flaky.

maya: tests pushed, CI rerun started.

deploy-bot: CI update — sdk#442: tests passed (integration), runtime#123: green, api#777: pending, charts#55: dry-run OK

kevin: starting API review now. aiming for approval in 90m if no surprises.

olivia: Thanks all. If approvals lag past 18:00 PT, bump here so I can escalate reviewers.

tia: noted. I'll post canary announcement in #deploys at 21:30 PT.

zane: staging chart smoke successful.

kevin: approved api#777 — left one tiny nits but not blocking.

samir: merged sdk#442 (auth mapping + release note). creating follow-up to flip compat flag.

maya: thanks — monitoring integration results on staging.

olivia: canary scheduled 22:00 PT. Thanks team.

samir: thanks everyone.

kevin: thanks :rocket:
